storyCards.headline: Superheroes: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
The Script's "Superheroes" reached #73 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Superheroes" is a song written by Danny O'Donoghue and Mark Sheehan of Irish pop rock band the Script with songwriter James Barry.

The song peaked at #73 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 9 weeks on the chart.

Superheroes was released in 2014.
